name: sftp-fail2ban
description: Easy to use SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) server with OpenSSH and Fail2ban installed for extra hardening against brute force attacks. Forked from atmoz/sftp. Based on Debian Slim Image. *Shared Path is an example. You must replace the host path with the path to a folder to share AND change the user in the container path to the name of a user account configured in users.conf. See the GitHub page for more info: https://github.com/bmartino1/sftp2.

paths.name: AdminData
paths.description: Default admin user's host folder/file access

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Docker data - this is needed to change the user.conf for multiple user accounts

ports.name: SSH Port
ports.description: Docker bridge network set SSH/SFTP port

variables.name: AUTO_UPDATE
variables.description: true Runs /stage/updateapps.sh if present custom Runs /config/updateapps.sh if present false or empty skips updates

variables.name: LOG_STREAMS
variables.description: auth,fail2ban,whois (comma-separated list for Docker stdout) Tail log streams.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASS
variables.description: CHANGE ME! Set the admin password!

variables.name: DEBUG_TESTING
variables.description: Preflight checks (makes sure Fail2ban and sshd will work) (writes to /config/debug when true), false by default

variables.name: TAIL_LOGS
variables.description: T/F enable Docker log showing tail logs. This doesn't stop them from writing to the log folder.

variables.name: CLEAR_LOGS
variables.description: At container restart, truncate logs in the log folder. This will move old logs within the log folder; no logs are removed.

variables.name: F2B_CONFIG_MODE
variables.description: How to handle /config Fail2ban files # ===== Fail2Ban config wiring ===== # How /etc/fail2ban is populated from /config/fail2ban: # - symlink (source of truth = /config) # - overlay (defaults + then /config over) # - noclobber (defaults + non-clobber copy from /config) # - replace (use /config only)
